tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal gshin rje'i gshed dmar po'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing*/ de bsgom par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du dpal gshin rje gshed bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du/ rang gi shes pa hūm̐ dmar po las/ rdo rje sngon po dang*/ mi mgo ser pos mtshan pa'i dbyug pa dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur pa las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad la phog pas/ sems can thams cad gshin rje gshed dmar por gyur/ tshur 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ ma he dmar po dang las kyi gshin rje khas phub tu bsgyel ba'i steng du/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das gshin rje gshed sku mdog dmar po/ zhabs g.yas bskum pas ma he'i rwa bar dang*/ g.yon brkyang bas tshang ra'i steng du brdzis pa/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rje dang*/ mi mgo dang bcas pa'i dbyug pa 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon pas bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa thugs kar 'dzin pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang*/ klu chen po brgyad kyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dbu skra sar po gyen du 'bar zhing*/ spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs shing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje ro langs ma sku mdog dmar mo/

phyag g.yas pas gri gug dang*/ g.yon pas khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ldan pa/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar pa'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam mo// gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po rnams sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsgoms la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ gshin rje gshed rigs lnga la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs kyis bskor ba spyan drangs/ de rnams la/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ badz+ra puṣ+pe/ badz+ra dhū pe/ badz+ra ā lo ke badz+ra gan+dhe/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod nas/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyis/ ye shes kyi chus bdag gi spyi bo nas dbang bskur zhing*/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsungs pas dbang gi chu rgyun spyi bo nas zhugs/ rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag dbang bzhi thob/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas gnyis ka'i spyi bor rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas/ dbang gi lha thams cad ye shes pa'i tshul gyis rang la gnyis su med par bstim pa dang*/ rang gi snying gar pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du/ rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' mtshon gang ba dang*/ de'i thugs kar hūm̐ dmar po nas 'bras tsam gyis ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' dmigs nas/ yum gyi bha ga pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa dang*/ yab kyi gsang gnas rdo rje rtse lnga par bskyed nas/ snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub sems kyi thig les yab yum gnyis kar gyi sku yongs su gang nas/

rjes su chags pa las byung ba'i zag pa med pa'i bde bas gnyis ka mnyes par byas/ de'i stobs kyis phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad gnyis su med pa'i bde bas mnyes/ sems can thams cad kyi sdug bsngal zhi/ zag pa med pa'i bde ba dang ldan par bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do// de nas thig le rnams ba spu'i bu ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rtser mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med par gnas pas bdag nyid la mchod par bsam zhing*/ oṃ rak+ta ya mā ri ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ/ zhes pa la sogs pa brjod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod la mchod pa'i lha mo de dag rang gi thugs kar thim par bsam mo// de nas lha'i sku sems dpa' sum brtsegs de nyid la dmigs la yid mnyam par gzhag go /sngags zlo ba'i tshe snying ga'i hūm̐ gi mtha' ma sngags kyi phreng bas g.yas skor du 'khor ba'i 'od kyis sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rgyas/ phyir 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul nas/ bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlob par bsam zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus pa bzla bar bya'o// spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad gshin rje gshed du bsgoms nas/ oṃ zhes pa dang*/ brjod pa dang grag pa thams cad sngags su bsgoms nas/ āḥzhes pa dang*/ sems kyi rtog pa thams cad ting nge 'dzin du bsgoms la/ hūm̐ zhes pas dngos po thams cad lha'i ngo bo snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan ltar dmigs la/ phyi'i lhas nang gi lha la mchod par bsam zhing ci bde bar longs spyad do// gtor ma gtong ba'i tshe/ gtor ma bshams pa a mri tas bsangs/ swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las/

āḥlas thod pa'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bskyed la/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang gi bsgoms pa lta bu'i ya mān+ta ka la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ chos skyong ba dang*/ 'jig rten pa thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs la/ de rnams kyis gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ hrīḥṣ+ṭ+rīḥwi kṛ tā na na rak+ta ya mā ri i maṃ ba liṃ gṛh+ṇa gṛh+ṇa ma ma bigh+nān/ ha ra ha ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun gyis dbul/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod nas/ bdag gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab bo// de nas/ oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes brjod la gtor ma'i mgron gshegs su gsol lo// zas za ba'i tshe/ kha zas gtor ma ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ rang gshin rje gshed du gsal bar dmigs pa'i thugs kar bla ma dang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' tshogs dang*/ lto bar phyogs skyong ba dang*/ 'jig rten skyong ba dang*/ 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad pa dmigs la/ de rnams la mchod pa'i bsam pas bza'o// rjes su chags pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ bskyed rim gyi bde ba bsgoms pa'i skabs dang 'dra'o// nyal ba'i tshe stong pa'i ngang la nyal zhing ldang ba'i tshe/ skad cig gis lha'i skur ldang ngo*// de ltar rtag tu rnal 'byor du byed pa ni gnas skabs su bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi zhing*/ bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du grub nas/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// rgyal bu a rog ches bskul nas// 'phags pas sgrub thabs sbyar ba yi// dge bas bdag dang sems can kun// gshin rje gshed dpal nyid gyur cig /dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ chu pho spre'u'i lo zla ba drug pa'i tshes lnga'i nyin par shing kun gyi sa char sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra zhes bya'o//
// ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
